intro.what_it_is: 这是一个用 C 编写的 Linux 本地提权概念验证，组合两个页缓存写入漏洞，在多个主流发行版上获取 root 权限。
intro.problem_solved: 它用于验证特定内核漏洞链能否稳定提权，并给出受影响版本、缓解办法和运行后的清理步骤。

intro.alternatives: 相比 Dirty Pipe 和 Copy Fail，它组合两个变体覆盖盲区，且不依赖竞态窗口。
intro.hype_or_trend: 短期热点，破千时已有 2,830 星，且本周上过一次日榜。
intro.risk_notes: 仅可用于授权测试；运行会污染页缓存，需清理或重启；披露时补丁和漏洞编号尚不存在。
evidence: This document describes the Dirty Frag vulnerability class, first discovered and reported by [Hyunwoo Kim (@v4bel)](https://x.com/v4bel), which can obtain root privileges on major Linux distributions by chaining the `xfrm-ESP Page-Cache Write (CVE-2026-43284)` vulnerability and the `RxRPC Page-Cache Write (CVE-2026-43500)` vulnerability.
This PoC is provided as accurate information following consultation with linux-distros. Do not use it on systems that you are not authorized to test.
⚠️  **Important:** After running this exploit, the page cache is contaminated.
